message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `partialRefund` treated `percent` as a multiplier, so a 50% refund returned 50× the amount. It now divides by 100, which matches the 0–100 contract in the file's comment.

The change is one line in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

`npm test` now passes 20/20. Before the fix it was 18/20, and the two failures were the partial-refund tests. The partial-refund test file passes on its own too. The only caller of `partialRefund` is that test, so nothing else was affected. I didn't touch any files outside `src/payments`, and I didn't commit.
